correctness.rationale: For φ(0)=01, φ(1)=00, all length≥3 factors of φ(w) have start parity determined by factor. Every terminal suffix of finite D_m occurs an odd number of times, eliminating the spurious exactly-two terminal source occurrence. With no MUS shorter than five beyond D3, the exact bijection MUS(D_(m+1))={[2i+1,2j):[i,j) in MUS(D_m)} is proved both directions. Base D3 has four length-three MUSs; their lifted intervals equal [N/4−1,N/2), [3N/8−1,5N/8), [N/2−1,3N/4), [3N/4−1,N), each length N/4+1 for all m≥3. Independent brute substring frequencies for m3..7 exactly confirmed the four intervals; not substituted for induction.
